|ingredients = {{Name|Potato|1}}{{Name|Oil|1}} }} '''Hashbrowns''' are a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. They are prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Hashbrowns may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. It is also sold by [[Alex]] during the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|10|calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. One Hashbrowns may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Sandy |hate=Leah |dislike=Harvey,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Hashbrowns are not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Complete Breakfast|RecipeRow}} {{:Dish O' The Sea|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Hashbrowns are used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Red Flannel Shirt]].
